methodology.cash_event_time: entitlement on ex-date, mapped to next common closing session if necessary
methodology.notional: Excluded from cash and unit reinvestment; separately audited
methodology.fx: Bank of Canada reference USD/CAD, carry-forward <=5 calendar days
methodology.monthly_regimes: TSLA CAD monthly return >+5%, within +/-5%, <-5%; first and last incomplete month excluded
methodology.data_validation: Distribution events are secondary-source seed pending official line-by-line verification; do not publish as final verified research.
methodology.market_price_quality: Market prices with |premium to NAV| over specified threshold excluded from ALL series on common calendar, raw data preserved; flagged rows not independently confirmed errors. Results provisional.
